name: Ambitious Plastomac Company Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1995, Ambitious Plastomac Ltd is in the business of Jobwork of Construction Activity[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
APL is in the business of manufacturing toys for toddlers. These toys feature no sharp edges or small parts and no PVC or toxic paint. They also do not work on batteries. Currently, the company is involved in infrastructure activities. 
This segment, encompasses project execution, construction, and related services, etc.

cons: Company has high debtors of 277 days.
